genreClassification.rationale: Guns N' Roses is a foundational band in hard and classic rock.

Ollama.targetTone: Mid-gain, aggressive crunch with a thick, slightly scooped midrange and pronounced bite. Needs to cut through a dense mix.
signatureElements: Slight fuzz character on the low end
Wah pedal sweep for rhythmic accents
gearHypotheses: High-gain overdrive model (e.g., Tube Screamer variant)
Amp simulation with a Marshall or Mesa Boogie profile
avoid: Overly scooped mids that lose definition

finalVerdict.targetTone: aggressive Slash-style Marshall crunch with wah bite
aggressive Slash-style Marshall crunch with wah bite

gp180.choicePolicy: Classic hard rock/blues crunch, emphasizing Marshall tones and wah.
gp180.bestMatchSummary: A classic Plexi-style setup using the UK 45 amp model, paired with a Wah pedal for signature bite, delivering tight, aggressive mid-range punch suitable for 'Welcome To The Jungle'.

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and unwanted noise from aggressive playing.
